title: Qualify released Lucene VarHandle reads and writes and test Guava transfer
description: Rerun both Lucene 8.11.0 and 9.0.0 fixed-width mixed compositions, signed, cursor, alias and VInt controls on identical public callers. Check plain integral view signatures, no-partial-store bounds, and refusals at atomic and object-identity operations. Test the same capability on Guava FarmHash public hashBytes using a separately assembled eight-byte word.
expected: Nine two-release observations, six independent caller and discriminator rows with all engine outputs, including refusals; the physical checks and exact run counts must pass.
